title: KODEX — KSCOUT: MF-CAMPAIGN
description:
KODEX — KSCOUT (MF-CAMPAIGN). multi-fidelity Bayesian-optimization campaign manager — extends KSEEK: chooses which operating point AND which fidelity (reduced twin / mu=400 CGYRO / real-mass gold) to run next, greedily maximizing truth-weighted information per GPU-hour under a budget

Benchmark: **multi-fidelity campaign**: tight 15.0 GPU-h over 16 hotspots → mean confidence ρ 0.638 vs 0.281 all-μ=400 (2.27×); triage-then-escalate

Part of KODEX, the Kronos Family of Codes — a benchmarked AI/ML fusion surrogate suite with calibrated uncertainty and an abstention gate (predict(x) → (y, uncertainty, in_domain)). Provenance: references 10.5281/zenodo.21842371. Home: https://kronosfusionenergy.com/kodex/kscout · suite: https://github.com/KronosFE/kronos-ml. Licensed under Apache-2.0. Honest card preserved verbatim.
